column1: # The seeded gate's parts (spec 2026-10-07 section 4, "Gate"; Phase 6.1 Task 10), read by
#   group        an ooTest group file below ootest/ooRexx, or a program relative to rust/
#   part         whole, derived or rest (as whole_groups runs them), single (one test alone),
#   k            the contended steps of the calibration run: seed 0 under fifo
#   seeds        seeds in a release build
#   debug        seeds in a debug build; 0 leaves the row out of the debug subset
#   release_ms   the calibration run's wall time, release
#   debug_ms     the calibration run's wall time, debug
#   knobs        appended to every run's mode, or -; fail= rows are judged by invariants only
#                and not compared with the oracle
#   left_out     tests left out beside the part's own (a rest row's refusing tests), a single
# Seed i of a row is splitmix(hash(group, part), i): output i of the splitmix64 stream
# starting at FNV-1a 64 of `group:part`. Its policy is entry i mod 7 of pre:1, pre:2, pre:3,
# pct:3, uniform:0.01, uniform:0.2, uniform:1, with k=k for pre and pct. A run's deadline is
# its calibrated time in the build times 10, and at least 60 s. The calibration and the seed
# counts are recorded in docs/superpowers/plans/phase-6-1-gate.md, ## Task 10.
# STREAM runs under clock=real: TEST_QUERYDIR_EXISTS and TEST_QUERYFILE_EXISTS_NOTOPEN compare
# .DateTime~new with the timestamp of a file just made on the real file system.
